title: No Rain
description: Removes the annoying rain particles so you can see while your moving fast!
body:
This texture pack removes rain!
Theres no more annoying rain while your moving fast!
Any support is appreciated:)
I hope this texture pack helps.
Please leave a heart if you like this resource pack, And im up for any suggestion in the discord linked above.
Please join the discord and ask me to make some texture packs!
